summary: The person's consent to exactly one thing they were shown: a download, a reviewed install plan, a setup program; invalid once that thing changes.

window.doc: The window where it was given.

token.doc: The token naming exactly what was shown (a release and hash, a plan hash, an installer ID).

shown.doc: What the person was shown, in plain data.

x-friction.gap: A download, an install or a setup run starts only with the person's consent to exactly what they saw; the consent must travel with the request and lapse when its subject changes.
x-friction.closes: Requests that carry consent as their reason, invalidated when the thing consented to changes.
